name: Encyclo-K
intro: Encyclo-K是一个基于语句的基准测试，它重新思考了基准测试的构建方式。其核心思想是知识语句而非问题可以作为策展单位，并可以从中构建问题。该基准测试通过从权威教科书中提取独立的知识语句，并在测试时通过随机抽样动态组合成评估问题，以解决数据污染、单知识点评估和昂贵领域专家标注的局限性。
org: Institute of Automation of the Chinese Academy Sciences, University of Manchester, Peking University
build_method: 教材截图, 视觉模型提取正确语句, 人工格式质检, DeepSeek-R1生成错误语句, 程序化动态组题
eval_feature: 语句级策展, 动态组题, 多知识点综合理解, 中英双语, 防污染
build_method_en: Textbook screenshots, vision-model fact extraction, human format QA, DeepSeek-R1 false statements, programmatic dynamic assembly
eval_feature_en: Statement-level curation, dynamic questions, multi-knowledge comprehension, bilingual, contamination resistance
intro_en: Encyclo-K is a statement-based benchmark that rethinks benchmark construction. Its core idea is that knowledge statements, rather than questions, serve as the curation units from which questions can be generated. This benchmark extracts independent knowledge statements from authoritative textbooks and dynamically assembles evaluation questions through random sampling during testing, addressing limitations such as data contamination, single-knowledge-point evaluation, and costly domain expert annotation.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.24867 Sections 3.1–4.2, Tables 1–2, and Appendix C. The diagram preserves the paper's two differently scoped hierarchy counts: Section 3.1.1 reports 62 selected textbooks spanning 43 source subfields across 11 disciplines, while Table 1 reports the final statement collection covering 44 fields and 62 subfields. It records manual screenshot capture and mosaic masking; doubao-1.5-vision-pro-32k extraction of standalone statements and titles; independence, completeness, clarity, and conciseness filters; removal of image-bearing, reference/formula, and ambiguous items; three-annotator review of 21,525 correct statements; DeepSeek-R1 generation with six error patterns and short-item filtering to 21,494 incorrect statements; the 43,019-statement pool; dynamic 8–10-statement, 4–8-option questions with 2–4 statements per option; discipline-proportional standard generation of 5,038 questions split into 3,286 English and 1,752 Chinese; and tiered regex/content fallback answer parsing where misses count as incorrect before accuracy reporting.
